_note: Draft Duel: best of 7 (the first to win wins_needed rounds wins; at most max_rounds, then most wins, or a draw). Before a match each player has a deck of deck_size animals from their collection. Each round, both players make picks_per_round picks: in round 1, starting animals from their deck; after that, from offer_animals animals from their deck and offer_tools of the tools they own, shown as two groups (rarer cards come up less, by rarity_weights). A pick takes an offered animal (one already in the army adds another squad of it), takes an offered tool (at most tools_max; a third replaces one), or upgrades an animal in the army (a star for all its squads). Stars go up to star_max; each star after the first adds star_bonus_pct to health and bite. An army holds at most army_max_units animals. Tools can be used once in every fight. Times are in seconds, distances in tiles; the fighting itself is tuned in battle_rules.json and classes.json.

bans._note: Before a match, once a player owns at least unlock_owned animals (a deck plus the rival's bans, so a deck can always be filled): a coin flip decides who bans first, then the two take turns until each has banned per_player animals. Nobody can use a banned animal that match. A ban of one of your own animals is refused if it could leave you fewer than a deck's worth once the rival's bans are in. The computer bans your animals that beat its favorite class (threats: favorite class -> the classes that beat it) at threat, your animals at owned (plus level for each level above the rarity's start), each point of power (cost) at power, never likes banning its favorite class (favorite, negative), and bans at most most_mythic of your Mythics a match; a weaker rival adds more luck (luck_easy to luck_hard).

rally._note: The War Horn (once a fight): your whole army surges for `seconds`, biting damage_pct harder, attacking attack_pct faster and moving speed_pct faster.

bot._note: How the computer opponent weighs a pick (scripts/draft/draft_bot.gd): a new animal starts at new_animal, another squad of one it has at squad, an upgrade at star (plus star_per_squad for each squad after the first), a tool at tool (plus tool_per_animal for each animal in its herd, at most 2; tool_swap when its belt is full). A card's power (its cost in animals.json, from 2 to 8) adds power per point above an ordinary 4.5. A class its herd doesn't have yet adds new_class; counters against your herd add up to 4 more. A Rival's style and some luck do the rest. A rival's deck has deck_favorite cards of its favorite class, at least one of every other class, and the rest its strongest picks.

field._note: The field grows for big herds, keeping its shape, and the camera zooms out to show all of it. scale 1 is 16 x 20 tiles. It starts growing when the bigger herd has more than grow_from_units animals on the field (a pack counts each animal) and reaches max_scale at grow_full_units; it also grows if the rows wouldn't fit otherwise. max_scale is the camera's zoom limit: animals are drawn 1/max_scale as big at most, so they stay readable on a phone. edge: how far (tiles) the last line stays from the back of the field.
